gen-fs-bevellier-gf-atkinson-hyperlegibl: Graceful in a flat, stencil-cut way, Bevellier packs its single-weight letters tightly, while Atkinson Hyperlegible sets an approachable sans text beneath. Long stretches feel easygoing, with clipped capitals keeping each word distinct.

Stencil-cut, flat and tightly packed: that's Bevellier up top. Bevellier excels at striking shapes with a pencil-line consistency, whereas Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono does best with open, widely spaced characters that stay distinct.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-biryani: Sophisticated from the first glance, Bevellier leads with flat, stencil-cut letters. Bevellier is best at making an entrance, while Biryani, every stroke uniform, is best at plain sans text that stays clear.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC feels contemporary, its curves finishing in clear openings. Beside Bevellier, whose line weight never varies, it carries long text approachably and without fuss, capitals and lowercase nearly level.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-chocolate-classical-: Sophisticated, rope-like strokes define Bevellier, while Chocolate Classical Sans offers a modern sans-serif body. And Bevellier earns its keep in big, short lines, where close-set letters get room to show off.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte is clean and neutral, with a wide-eyed e and a prominent x-height, tucked under the stencil-cut Bevellier. Cossette Texte does well at modest sizes, so save the bigger ones for Bevellier.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans lets its small letters dominate the line, with generous openings. Duru Sans does best at carrying text, while Bevellier, its strokes pulled like solder through a nozzle, does best at drawing the eye.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-gafata: Gafata is a tall band of letters with short stalks above, a contemporary foil to Bevellier's ruler-and-compass line. Longer text moves along at a steady, professional clip without any fuss.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-geist: Flat stencil cuts, tightly spaced, give Bevellier its look, with Geist keeping a quiet, level beat beneath. And Geist sets words as solid blocks rather than skylines, leaving Bevellier all the attention.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-golos-text: Golos Text lets its x-height fill the line, in strokes of one width. Bevellier supplies stencil-cut drama up top, while the widely parted s in Golos Text keeps everything below approachable.
